assets.title: Small Postal Service Corner
assets.description: Original postal corner on a 3.4x2.3m base with an arched street letterbox and a six-cell sorting cabinet. Two labelled parcel shapes occupy the lower centre cubby. Editable source parts; no operational postal service, door animation or structural certification is included.

assets.title: Arched Street Letterbox
assets.description: Original arched street letterbox on a grounded pedestal. The mail slot is a real closed recess in the shell. Separate access-door panel, latch and blank label plaque are editable. Overall height 1.33m; visual game prop without functional delivery or opening animation.

assets.title: Six-Cell Postal Sorting Module
assets.description: Original six-cell open-front sorting cabinet on four legs. Actual cabinet width 1.2m, nominal repeat spacing 1.22m along X leaves a 20mm installation gap. Depth including feet 0.46m; top Z=1.1m. Separate frame, shelves, back and dividers; visual asset without load rating.

assets.title: Static Parcel Tabletop Scale
assets.description: Original S01 static tabletop parcel scale with four feet, a separate weighing platform and a raised rear inclined display head. Twelve named editable GLB mesh nodes retain actual placement transforms. The unlit display and two keys are static geometry. Actual unchanged legacy parcel support and display clearance are checked in the documented pose; see generate.py opening documentation. Only this scale is a new asset; parcels and all hosts are reused. The handtruck use is one tested upright static placement, not dynamic transport. No weighing accuracy, capacity, calibration, scanning, payment or load simulation.
